ModMetaData.name: Dubs Lite - Async Sewage Mesh Workaround
ModMetaData.author: Local compatibility patch
ModMetaData.description: Experimental RimWorld 1.6 workaround. Prevents the unused sewage map layer of Dubs Bad Hygiene Lite from creating Unity meshes on background map-generation threads. Load after Dubs Bad Hygiene Lite. This does not fix unsafe background map generation in other mods.
